rule: At the common matching scale require x=c^k and z=c exp(i phi), c=|Vud|. Keep the defined charged vertices, the real zero-return condition, the frozen neutral direction at its two thresholds and the three measured charged-lepton masses. Solve for all three down Yukawas and gamma; the weak CKM moduli are either at their direct centers or at their previously registered offsets. No new Lagrangian assumed to select k or suppress complementary paths.
